title: Tshepo ya Ntlha e e Thubegileng kwa Paradaiseng
intro: Akanya fela o eme mo tshingwaneng ya kagiso e e itekanetseng, o tlotliwa go feta popo yotlhe, o na le molelwane o le mongwe fela o o tshwanetseng go o tlotla. Go seba go solofetsa bosakhutleng, tlhopho e le nngwe fela e fetola sengwe le sengwe, mme le fa go ntse jalo kutlwelobotlhoko e bula tsela ya go boela morago. Ke mang yo o buang go tswa kwa tshimologong ya batho?
clues: Ke bopilwe ke Allah ka letsopa mme ka bopiwa ka tlhokomelo ya bomodimo.
Ke ne ka tlotliwa fa Allah a ne a laela baengele gore ba nkhubamele.
Ke ne ke nna mo Paradaiseng le molekane wa me, ke gololesegile go itumelela dilo tsotlhe kwantle ga setlhare se le sengwe fela.
Ke ne ka tsiediwa ke go sebaseba ga ga Satane yo o neng a ikana gore o tla nna mogakolodi yo o tlhoafetseng.
Ke ne ka ja leungo la setlhare se se ileditsweng mme sekhurumetso sa me sa tlosiwa ka ntlha ya ditlhong.
Ke ithutile mafoko a go ikwatlhaya mo Moreneng wa me, mme Allah a retologela kwa go nna ka kutlwelobotlhoko.

outcome.label: Botso
options: Ke ne ka nwela mo morwaleleng o mogolo le baheitane .
Allah o nthutile mafoko a boikwatlhao mme a intshwarela
Ke ne ka itewa ke legadima ka ntlha ya go batla go bona Allah
Ke ne ke meditswe ke tlhapi e kgolo ka ntlha ya go tsamaya ke galefile
Ke ne ka fetolwa le batho ba gaetsho ka ntlha ya go tlola Sabata
outcome.answer: Allah o nthutile mafoko a boikwatlhao mme a intshwarela

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
